ties.crossDivision: Arsenal play in the Premier League and Wrexham in the Championship, so these columns are two different scales. The two divisions average almost the same fouls per match, but second-tier rates are spread far wider, and only about 37% of a club's distance from its own division's average carries into the top flight. Read each side against its own league, not against the other.
